tasks.label: Start Formora AI Server
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$conn = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port 8787 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $conn.TcpTestSucceeded) { Write-Host 'Starting Formora AI Server on port 8787...'; Set-Location Formora/Website; node server.js } else { Write-Host 'Formora AI Server is already active on port 8787.' }"
